summary.text: Ted Brown, a Libertarian Party candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for U.S. Senate in Texas to James Talarico, receiving 1.9% of the vote to James Talarico's 55.1%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
He won the party's April 11, 2026 convention over Daniel Mark Sims.
